thread:
Riley (SRE Lead): Noticed a bunch of open PMs from Q4 with no owners. Can we agree on a lightweight closure workflow so follow-ups actually get done?
Nora (PM): +1. Proposal: each postmortem must produce a minimum set of actions: owner, due date (auto-filled by severity), verification step, recurrence tag.
Ezra (Oncall): Severity->due mapping please?
Riley (SRE Lead): My thought: Sev1->7d, Sev2->21d, Sev3->60d. Owners must be assigned within 48h or the oncall lead gets pinged.
Priya (Infra): We should add a "runbook update" flag for infra changes so docs don't rot.
Nora (PM): Also want to auto-surface recurring patterns in the weekly ops retro. Could we add labels like "rec:cache","rec:auth" plus a recurrence_score that increments on similar RCAs?
Ezra (Oncall): Love that. Practically, can the incident pipeline match on error signature + service + stacktrace hash? If score > 2 show in retro.
DevOps-bot: DevOps Bot: created ticket INFRA-8123 from postmortem "auth-latency-spike" assigned to oncall-rotation due 2026-03-29.
Alex (Eng): For tickets: include a small 'verification checklist' in the description so reviewers know what to validate (metrics delta, smoke test, deploy canary).
Riley (SRE Lead): Agreed. I'll add a template snippet to the postmortem checklist: 
```
- Action: fix auth retry backoff
- Owner: @alex
- Due: 2026-03-29 (Sev2)
- Verification: reduce 95th latency by 30% on canary for 24h
- Recurrence tag: rec:auth
```
Nora (PM): Communication cadence proposal: 1) Incident alert and brief in #incidents; 2) 24h status in same channel; 3) final postmortem + action queue link when verification done. Internal stakeholders get optional subscription.
Ezra (Oncall): Can we require a 30m triage slot on Mondays to go through new actions older than 7d? Rotate chair between oncall and SRE lead.
Priya (Infra): I'll add a "cost impact" field to prioritize actions (est. minutes of downtime, affected customers). Helps product prioritize tradeoffs.
Alex (Eng): Who owns recurrence detection? Ops or Eng? I can prototype a query in observability to surface repeated error signatures.
Riley (SRE Lead): Ops should own the detector, Eng owns remediation. Set marker if same service triggers x3 within 30 days.
Nora (PM): If an action is unowned after 48h it escalates to the incident commander for assignment; if overdue escalate weekly to the relevant manager.
Ezra (Oncall): For the incident commander rotation, add a single line to the rota: "IC rotates weekly; IC handles escalations for open actions from their week for 48h post-incident."
DevOps-bot: DevOps Bot: reminder set to check INFRA-8123 in 3 days.
Riley (SRE Lead): I'll draft the Action Queue board (columns: Backlog, Triage, In Progress, Verifying, Done) and default SLA label rules. Will share tomorrow.
Nora (PM): I'll update the postmortem template with the new fields and publish a short HOWTO for owners.
Alex (Eng): Happy to help with the detector prototype, will post results in #eng-metrics.
Priya (Infra): Once we have the board, let's run a 30-day pilot and re-evaluate recurrence thresholds and SLAs.
Riley (SRE Lead): Sounds good. Small steps 	6% ok.
Ezra (Oncall): Thanks everyone 44D. Ping me if you want me to chair the first triage.
Nora (PM): Thanks all. I'll schedule a 20m sync to align labels and escalation contacts.
